'''Fiyarro''' was one of the three largest [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

==History==
These cities were well known for the anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tendencies and were home to some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] wealthiest benefactors.<ref name="DB:ROT" /> [[Saffia/Legends|Saffia]] and [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]] were very similar to Fiyarro.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
